Lord Barst Berengarsson was an Imperial general known for his cunning and his prowess in battle. He was a trusted and loyal follower of Galbatorix and served as one of his master's highest ranking commanders. In the assault on Urû'baen, he wielded a massive spiked mace and seemed impervious to harm, even to the formidable magical attacks of the elves, due to being empowered by one or more of Galbatorix's cache of Eldunarí.
